record.paper_title: Regularity of maximal operators: recent progress and some open problems
record.original_question: Let M_S be the spherical maximal operator on R^d, defined by taking the supremum over r>0 of the average of |f| on the sphere S^{d-1}(x,r). For dimensions d >= 2, is M_S bounded from W^{1,p}(R^d) to W^{1,p}(R^d) for the full range 1 < p <= d/(d-1)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d \geq 2$ and, for a locally integrable function $f:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$, define the spherical maximal operator
$$ M_S f(x) \;=\; \sup_{r>0} \left| \int_{S^{d-1}} f(x+r\omega)\, d\sigma(\omega) \right|, $$
where $d\sigma$ denotes the normalized surface measure on the unit sphere $S^{d-1}\subset\mathbb{R}^d$. For $1<p<\infty$, let $W^{1,p}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ denote the Sobolev space of $L^p$ functions whose distributional gradient also lies in $L^p$, equipped with the norm $\|f\|_{W^{1,p}}=\|f\|_{L^p}+\|\nabla f\|_{L^p}$.

Determine whether $M_S$ is bounded as an operator from $W^{1,p}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ to $W^{1,p}(\mathbb{R}^d)$ for every exponent $p$ in the full range $1<p\leq \tfrac{d}{d-1}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Standard references on the regularity of maximal operators identify Sobolev boundedness of the spherical maximal operator $M_S:W^{1,p}\to W^{1,p}$ in the endpoint range $1<p\le d/(d-1)$ as an unresolved question; boundedness is known for $d/(d-1)<p<\infty$ (in the $L^p$-bounded range of Stein/Bourgain), while the endpoint range below $d/(d-1)$ has not been established. No source found establishing or refuting the full range.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of maximal operators: recent progress and some open problems (arXiv)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses open questions about Sobolev regularity of the spherical maximal operator, including the endpoint range.
status_evidence.claim: The Sobolev boundedness of $M_S$ on $W^{1,p}$ for $1<p\le d/(d-1)$ is listed as open.

status_evidence.title: Maximal Potentials, Maximal Singular Integrals, and the Spherical Maximal (Hajłasz)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses boundedness of the spherical maximal operator from W^{1,p} to homogeneous Sobolev spaces; the endpoint range below d/(d-1) is identified as an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Endpoint Sobolev boundedness of the spherical maximal operator remains open.
